title: Finish repo hygiene: ignored tracked files, root layout, npm advisories

Work now: untrack or un-ignore the 14 paths (decide per path), remove python/uv.lock, fold INSTALL.md into CONTRIBUTING.md, move planning/ and the video folders under videos/, fix the npm advisories in apps/console and packages/ui and add npm audit --audit-level=high to CI for those two.
